description: Wever Briefs: a monthly USDC statement for one Base address, the expense close pack. Input address (the form wever_wallet-activity-brief accepts) and month (YYYY-MM, the current month to date or one of the twelve before it). The signed statement gives total USDC in and out on Base, the net change, transfer counts, up to 10 largest transfers with dates and counterparty addresses, and the opening and closing balances where the readers establish them, laid out as plain statement lines for a person or an accountant. It reads the public Base USDC Transfer logs and balance through the wallet activity brief readers. POST /api/wallet-statement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/briefs/.

address.description: Public Base address, the same form wever_wallet-activity-brief accepts. Mixed-case input must carry a valid EIP-55 checksum; all-lowercase input is normalized.

month.description: The calendar month in UTC, YYYY-MM: the current month (to date) or one of the twelve before it.

name: wever_wallet-statement
